narr: Low pressure meandering along a stalled frontal boundary produced scattered showers and thunderstorms across the region. With light upper level flow, these storms were generally slow moving, resulting in flash flooding across portions of urban northeast New Jersey. Rainfall amounts in the heaviest storms ranged from around 1 to 1.5 inches, including 1.47 inches reported by the Newark Airport ASOS.
ev: Numerous roads were closed due to flooding in Jersey City.
Numerous roads were closed due to flooding in Kearny.
Severe local flooding was reported just north of the train station in the town of Kearny. Water rescues were performed on Schuyler Avenue to assist motorists trapped in flood waters.
Cars were reported stranded in flood waters in Jersey City.
All lanes were closed due to flooding on the US 1&9 truck route northbound at the New Jersey Turnpike in Newark.
